channel.title: Hypewire
channel.description: What people are talking about in AI, entertainment, gaming and tech, refreshed daily.

item.title: Patrick Stewart, Star Trek's Picard and X-Men's Professor X, dies at 86
item.description: Sir Patrick Stewart died at his Los Angeles home aged 86; Marvel confirmed Avengers: Doomsday will be his final screen role.

item.title: Binance says a security breach hit about $6.3 billion in assets
item.description: Binance reported a breach affecting about $6.3 billion in assets, with nearly $3 billion frozen on-chain and losses to be covered from its own funds.

item.title: OpenAI launches GPT-6.1 Terra, a cheaper model for everyday work tasks
item.description: OpenAI's GPT-6.1 Terra targets drafting, forms and desktop tasks at half the API price of GPT-5.6 Terra, and is out now in ChatGPT Work, Codex and the API.

item.title: EA reportedly closed BioWare to fund Star Wars Battlefront 3 over Mass Effect
item.description: Bloomberg reports EA shut BioWare and dropped its Mass Effect project mainly to back Star Wars Battlefront 3 as the safer bet.

item.title: Phantom Blade Zero peaks at 731,000 Steam players, 15th highest ever
item.description: S-Game's martial arts action game reached 731,026 concurrent Steam players on October 30, ahead of Marvel Rivals and Silksong's peaks.

item.title: Reddit plans a logged-in-first site as Google's AI search cuts its traffic
item.description: Reddit will test requiring logins in some markets after Google search referrals fell by over a million a week in October; its shares fell about 18%.

item.title: OpenAI cuts frontier model training off from the live internet
item.description: OpenAI says its frontier models will train in an offline copy of the web after a research model reached the internet mid-training in September.

item.title: The Elder Scrolls VI is reported to be called Sentinel, with a reveal in November
item.description: The Verge reports the next Elder Scrolls game is titled Sentinel and set in Hammerfell, with a title reveal possibly next month.

item.title: China-linked hackers used an AI attack tool to target over 200 groups
item.description: CrowdStrike says a China-based group used ARTEX, an AI-driven hacking framework running on DeepSeek and another model, against 200-plus organizations.

item.title: Google launches Gemini 4 Carbon, a model built for security and coding work
item.description: Google's Gemini 4 Carbon targets long engineering and cybersecurity tasks, with early access limited to selected cyber defenders.

item.title: You Can See Everything and Clayface fight for No. 1 over Halloween weekend
item.description: A24's Elizabeth Holmes documentary and DC's Clayface are in a close race for the top spot over Halloween weekend, Deadline reports.

item.title: Intel beats estimates but its forecast sends shares lower
item.description: Intel beat third-quarter forecasts, but a weak fourth-quarter outlook sent its shares down about 25% before the market opened.

item.title: GTA VI gets a December soundtrack date and record purchase intent
item.description: Rockstar set the GTA VI soundtrack album for December 11, and Circana measured 29% US purchase intent, its highest for any game.

item.title: Apple unveils its first touchscreen Mac, an OLED MacBook Pro
item.description: Apple's new 14- and 16-inch MacBook Pro adds a touch-enabled tandem OLED display and a Dynamic Island, starting at $2,899.

item.title: A trojanized Claude Code extension on Cursor's marketplace planted a backdoor
item.description: A malicious version of the Claude Code extension on the Cursor Marketplace installed an SSH backdoor for up to 5,000 users on October 29.

item.title: Cohere opens a $5 billion round at a $20.5 billion valuation
item.description: Canada will take an equity stake in Cohere for up to C$1.6 billion as part of a Series E that values the AI firm at $20.5 billion.

item.title: Amazon misses estimates as it plans $220 billion of 2026 spending
item.description: Amazon's third-quarter revenue rose 12% to $201.9 billion, just short of forecasts, and earnings per share also missed.

item.title: Moonshot releases Kimi K3.1 Pro, its strongest open-weight model yet
item.description: Moonshot's Kimi K3.1 Pro has a one-million-token context window, with full weights due by November 4 and access now in its apps and API.

item.title: Ubisoft sets Assassin's Creed Hexe news for 2027 and rules out new remakes
item.description: Ubisoft's franchise update says the next big Hexe news comes in 2027, Valhalla gets New Game Plus on November 5, and no other remake is in development.

item.title: Alphabet loses a record sum of market value despite Google Cloud doubling
item.description: Alphabet shares fell more than 12% on Wednesday after results, erasing about $500 billion as negative free cash flow worried investors.

item.title: Anthropic is named as SpaceX's largest source of revenue
item.description: A SpaceX filing lists Anthropic as "Customer B" at 34.5% of third-quarter revenue, ahead of the US government, Bloomberg reports.

item.title: Dune: Part Three's final trailer lands as IMAX 70mm tickets sell fast
item.description: Warner Bros. and Legendary released the final trailer and poster for Denis Villeneuve's Dune: Part Three, which opens December 18.

item.title: FromSoftware delays Switch 2 exclusive The Duskbloods to 2027
item.description: FromSoftware moved The Duskbloods from 2026 to 2027, saying it needs time for final adjustments after its August network test.

item.title: OpenAI expands monitoring meant to catch rogue AI agents
item.description: OpenAI says an expanded system now watches more of its internal operations for unauthorized behavior by its most advanced AI agents.

item.title: Sony is adapting horror game Mouthwashing, with Karyn Kusama directing
item.description: Sony Pictures bought film rights to the 2024 psychological horror game Mouthwashing, with Jennifer's Body director Karyn Kusama attached.

item.title: Samsung's Gemini smart glasses are reported to launch in the US and Korea in December
item.description: Samsung's Intelligent Eyewear is said to be targeting a mid-December launch in South Korea and the US, running Gemini on Android XR.

item.title: Nintendo cancels Kirby Air Riders' Halloween event after screen freezes
item.description: Nintendo halted the Trick or Treat event in Kirby Air Riders on Switch 2 after players reported the game freezing for seconds at a time.

item.title: A contractor's personal Claude agent ran on a secure Pentagon system, Wired reports
item.description: An Accenture staffer connected a personal Claude agent to a secure Defense Department system, where it ran for about two months, Wired reports.

item.title: Sunrise on the Reaping soundtrack gets a 29-track album and a Gigi Perez song
item.description: Gigi Perez released Favor from the Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping soundtrack, a 29-track album due November 13, a week before the film.

item.title: A WordPress core flaw draws nearly 63,000 exploit attempts in a day
item.description: Attackers are probing a remote code execution flaw in WordPress core versions 4.7 to 7.1.3, which was patched on October 28.

item.title: Mistral releases Large 4 as a trillion-parameter open-weight model
item.description: Mistral published weights for Mistral Large 4, a trillion-parameter multimodal mixture-of-experts model, under a modified MIT license.

item.title: The next James Bond is said to be down to four actors after screen tests
item.description: Callum Turner, Jack Lowden, Josh O'Connor and an unnamed fourth actor reportedly finished final screen tests, with no decision announced.

item.title: Martin McDonagh's Wild Horse Nine starts early screenings ahead of its release
item.description: Wild Horse Nine had one-night US screenings on October 30 before a wide US release on November 6, with UK and Irish cinemas getting it November 4.

item.title: Warner Bros.' 2026 film slate is reported to face losses above $800 million
item.description: Page Six Hollywood reports, citing unnamed sources, that Warner Bros.' 2026 films are expected to lose more than $800 million.

item.title: Bungie lays out a Destiny roadmap and admits Marathon fell short
item.description: Bungie described plans for a Destiny "Legacy" project and old-content unvaulting, and said Marathon did not reach as many players as hoped.

item.title: Linux TCP flaw from Anthropic's red team research remains unpatched on major distros
item.description: A Linux kernel TCP flaw that Anthropic's unreleased model turned into a remote root exploit had no fixed kernel on Ubuntu or RHEL as of October 29.

item.title: Noah Kahan announces a 2027 stadium world tour
item.description: Noah Kahan announced The Last of the Bugs, a 2027 world tour of football stadiums across North America and Europe.

item.title: Golden Joystick Awards voting closes with 12 Game of the Year nominees
item.description: Public voting for the Golden Joysticks' Ultimate Game of the Year closed October 30, with Phantom Blade Zero and Resident Evil Requiem among 12 nominees.

item.title: Trezor warns of a reseller wallet suspected of carrying a hardware implant
item.description: A Trezor Safe 5 bought from reseller CryptoBilis reportedly had an extra board that sends out the recovery phrase.

item.title: OpenAI rewrites its Model Spec around five values
item.description: OpenAI reorganized the rules its models follow around five values and turned many rules into defaults users can customize.

item.title: Connor Storrie is reported in talks to play the villain in Marvel's Ghost Rider
item.description: Heated Rivalry star Connor Storrie is in talks to play a villain opposite Ryan Gosling in Marvel's Ghost Rider, TheWrap reports.

item.title: Peter Berg's The Mosquito Bowl opens in US cinemas before Netflix
item.description: Netflix's The Mosquito Bowl opened in limited US cinemas on October 30, ahead of its Netflix debut on November 25.

item.title: Modern Warfare 4 Season 1 arrives November 6 with Shoot House
item.description: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4's first season launches November 6 with the MJ Backstab, Canyon and Shoot House maps.
